hooks.command: if [[ "${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}" == *.py ]] && command -v ruff &>/dev/null; then ruff check --quiet "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi

hooks.prompt: Decide whether this Stop is an ordinary turn or the genuine completion of substantial user-assigned work. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS. Inspect last_assistant_message and session_id. Return {"ok":true} for an ordinary turn, a question, partial progress, a status/checkpoint, waiting on CI/review/background work, or any case where more work remains. Also return ok=true when the last_assistant_message says the matching workspace_global handoff/result with gar-session:<session_id> was already completed. ONLY when the substantial assignment is genuinely finished and no matching session-end handoff was completed, return {"ok":false,"reason":"Run /session-end now. Post the verified workspace_global handoff/result with receipt token gar-session:<session_id>, then finish."}. Never force /session-end for casual conversation or an ordinary turn.

sessionStart: git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ' | xargs -I{} echo 'uncommitted files: {}'
